description: This file contains the implementation of socket waiting and checking functions, primarily around select() and poll() mechanisms, for the curl project. It includes functions for waiting a specific number of milliseconds, checking socket readiness, and handling cross-platform compatibility issues.

methods.name: int Curl_wait_ms(timediff_t timeout_ms)
methods.description: Waits for a specified amount of milliseconds, handling different platform-specific implementations including Windows, MSDOS, and Unix.

methods.name: int our_select(curl_socket_t maxfd,fd_set * fds_read,fd_set * fds_write,fd_set * fds_err,timediff_t timeout_ms)
methods.description: Wrapper around the select() system call for Windows compatibility, handling fd_set and timeout parameters.

methods.name: int Curl_socket_check(curl_socket_t readfd0,curl_socket_t readfd1,curl_socket_t writefd,timediff_t timeout_ms)
methods.description: Checks readiness of up to three sockets (read and write), with a timeout, returning bitmask flags indicating socket status.

methods.name: int Curl_poll(struct pollfd ufds[],unsigned int nfds,timediff_t timeout_ms)
methods.description: Wrapper around poll() or select() for cross-platform socket events checking, with timeout support.

ctags.name: Curl_poll
ctags.pattern: /^int Curl_poll(struct pollfd ufds[], unsigned int nfds, timediff_t timeout_ms)$/

ctags.pattern: /^int Curl_socket_check(curl_socket_t readfd0, \/* two sockets to read from *\/$/

ctags.pattern: /^static int our_select(curl_socket_t maxfd,   \/* highest socket number *\/$/
